name: Maddeth Liquidation Lab
notes: TESTNET ONLY. This lab is intentionally isolated from the canonical Maddeth KUB Testnet pool and oracle.
The lab oracle can only toggle labKUB between fixed $10 and $8 prices; it cannot set arbitrary prices or price canonical assets.
labKUB and labUSDC are public-mint test assets with no production value.
The intended demo is Wallet A opens a healthy position, anyone toggles the bounded price shock, then Wallet B liquidates Wallet A.

Recovered from successful Deploy KUB Liquidation Lab run 34848542844 after all 11 broadcast receipts succeeded; the original workflow stopped only because Foundry's annotated uint output was parsed as a Bash integer.
